Bill.BriefDescription: Limiting the sale and serving of minimally nutritional food on public school campuses.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to foods of minimal nutritional value sold andserved on public school campuses; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Each school district shall ensure thatstudents in elementary schools do not have access to foods of minimalnutritional value except on special occasions or as permitted insubsection (5) of this section. (2) Each school district shall ensure that students in middleschools do not have access to foods of minimal nutritional value exceptafter school, at events that take place in the evening, and on specialoccasions. (3) Each school district shall ensure that students in high schoolsdo not have access to foods of minimal nutritional value until one hourafter the last lunch period. (4) For purposes of this section, "foods of minimal nutritionalvalue" means any foods so defined in Section 210.11 of Title 7 of theCode of Federal Regulations and listed in Appendix B of the regulationsfor the national school lunch program. p. 1 SB 5825 (5) This section shall not be construed to prohibit the sale ordistribution of any food or beverage item through periodic fundraisersby a student, a teacher, or school group when the item is for saleafter completion of the school day.
